other_conditions: Farmers must be able to bear additional costs as per departmental recommendations.
The selected demonstration area must have irrigation facilities in addition to dryland farming.
Only one member from a farmer's family is eligible for demonstration.
Demonstrations are organized at the block level.
Selected seeds, fertilizers, and other inputs must be used according to guidelines.
A farmer can set up a demonstration plot of up to 1 hectare, or less on a pro‑rated basis.
Under the National Food Security Mission, the plot must be at least 0.4 hectares.
Farmers who have not benefited from crop demonstration programs in the past three years are eligible.
benefits_summary: Grants covering up to 100% of actual input costs for a range of crops, with a 50% contribution for oilseed crops up to specified monetary limits.
